rowText: With Half-Life 2 running, ask an on-game question the notes cannot answer ("what year did half-life 2 come out"). Pass when the "Not in my notes" line appears once, worded exactly, and sits below the answer without breaking the D-pad walk.

steps.action: Exited Hades cleanly (rig's exit tool, Confirm pressed once, appid left RunningApps).
Tried to launch Half-Life 2 (appid 220) with the rig's launch tool.
steps.observed: Refused before pressing anything meaningful: Half-Life 2 is not on the Recent Games shelf right now (only Hades had been played this session before this point), and the launch tool only searches that shelf. The tool's own message: play it once by hand so it appears there.

verdictSentence: Could not even get Half-Life 2 running tonight -- the automatic launcher only looks at the Recent Games row, and Half-Life 2 had fallen off it after everything else played earlier in the session. On top of that, the pinned-question box that this row would have needed was no longer offering pinned sentences at all by this point (see plan61-MEGAERA-01-retry2.json) -- so even with Half-Life 2 running, this question could not have been sent by the sanctioned pinned-chip route.
notes: Two separate blockers stacked: the game could not be launched, and the pinned-question mechanism had already stopped working earlier in this same session. Recommend someone play Half-Life 2 once by hand to put it back on the shelf, and separately look at why pinned test chips stop appearing after the first one or two sends.
